test_index_view: test the index_view helper function that creates an index view from a DataFrame column
test_set_index_update_column: test set_index with drop=False disconnects the index from the original column after modification
test_set_index_drop_update_column: test set_index with drop=True disconnects the index from the original DataFrame column
test_index_ops: test index operations including view, take, repeat, slicing, delete, rename, and astype preserve copy_view behavior
test_index_to_frame: test Index.to_frame creates a DataFrame that shares memory with the original index values
test_constructor_copy_input_ndarray_defa: test Index constructor copies input ndarray by default and does not share memory
test_index_from_series_copy: test Index constructor with copy=True shares memory with the source Series array
test_assign_index_as_series: test assigning a Series as DataFrame index disconnects it from the original Series
test_infer_objects: test Index.infer_objects with copy=False preserves copy_view disconnect from original data
